verdict.rationale: Any public website can publish a robots.txt, so this axis applies to IP India's web services. The evidence pack has no probe or documentation of a robots.txt at ipindia.gov.in. The only agent-access probe covers llms.txt, which is a different file, and its 404 does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
